title: Iconography overview

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Give familiar actions a consistent visual shorthand so users can recognize functionality at a glance.
strategic_value: An approved icon family can support Verizon recognition while reducing competing symbol styles.
demonstration: The February 1, 2021 overview combines a sample icon grid, an annotated Search example, library links, interface examples and presentation-template previews.
practical_value: Use the approved library for the channel and request a missing icon instead of creating an unrelated substitute.

content_islands.name: Definition and sample set
content_islands.spec: Place the black title banner above the usage policy and three rows of sample outline symbols.

content_islands.name: Meaning and retrieval
content_islands.spec: Pair the Search specimen with its usability explanation, followed by icon-index and usage cards.

content_islands.name: Channel examples
content_islands.spec: Show digital navigation and feedback examples, then PowerPoint and Google Slides template previews at the bottom.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains that icons convey information at a glance and clarify functionality when used correctly.
reference_purposes.Application: The page demonstrates icon use in navigation, notifications and presentation templates.
reference_purposes.Constraint: It restricts use to the system’s icons, asks creators not to make their own, and directs missing-icon requests to the brand team.

ingredient.name: Approved icon family
ingredient.role: Provide a recognizable shorthand for actions and information.
ingredient.application: Use icons from the system; request a missing symbol. Consult the web/app subset or full Brand Central library as directed.
ingredient.scope: Iconography overview updated February 1, 2021. The full downloadable libraries and templates are not included here.
